chunks: And whatever is in it from Abū Hāshim al-Jaʿfarī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Barqī, from Abū Hāshim al-Jaʿfarī.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū Hāshim al-Jaʿfarī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abū Hāshim al-Jaʿfarī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and identifying the intermediaries through whom the narration was received.
